# Installing Atlas
https://atlas.example/docs/install

Atlas requires Python 3.11 or newer and runs on Linux and macOS.
Install with: pip install atlas-cli
Then run `atlas init` once per project.
After installing, set the values described in the configuration guide.

Links:
- https://atlas.example/docs/config
